description: Install a skill by owner/name slug: validates it, then writes one canonical copy (.agents/skills/<name>) and links it into the chosen agents' skill directories. Never executes scripts. Skills it depends on (it calls them with the Skill tool or by name) are installed with it, from the same owner, and reported as also_installed; the ones it merely points at are reported as related. The response reports the skill's capability flags (docs_only, network_calls, executes_scripts, reads_secrets) as information.

agents.description: Agent ids to link the skill into (default: every agent detected on this machine)

deny.description: Refuse the skill if it carries any of these security flags

dest.description: Deprecated: an explicit agent skills directory. Must be a known agent skills dir; prefer scope + agents.

force.description: Replace a skill installed from a different source or an untracked directory

mode.description: link (junction/symlink to the canonical copy, default) or copy

scope.description: project = the current directory's agent folders (default when the cwd looks like a project); global = the user's home-level agent folders

slug.description: Skill identifier as owner/name, e.g. anthropic/pdf

with_related.description: Also install the skills this skill only points at (see, link). Skills it calls (the Skill tool, 'use the X skill') are always installed with it and reported as also_installed.

name: skillmd_install

also_blocked.description: Dependencies that were not installed because they failed a check; the skill itself was installed. Absent when there were none

also_installed.description: Skills this skill depends on (it calls them with the Skill tool or by name), installed alongside it; absent when there were none

used_by.description: owner/name of the skill that needs it

canonical.description: Absolute path of the canonical copy every target links to

note.description: Caveats, e.g. when only SKILL.md could be written

related.description: Skills the skill only points at (see, link), not installed; pass with_related to install them. Absent when there were none

kind.description: How the skill points at it: see, link, or a call that hangs off one of those

via.description: owner/name of the skill that points at it

scope.description: Which set of agent folders was written

security_flags.description: Capability flags reported for the skill

skipped.description: Agents that were not written, with the reason

targets.description: Agent skill dirs the canonical copy was linked or copied into; empty when only the canonical copy was written

title: Install skill
